confirmed_fixed_behaviors: Incomplete and operationally late captures remain immutable evidence but no longer establish successful collection health.
Latest successful event binds exact source SHA, both-market completeness, timeliness, target slot, and causal collection clock.
A failure wins an ambiguous same-second tie; neutral events do not clear it; legacy incomplete/late success metadata is rechecked from actual source bytes.
Incoming source receipt timestamps cannot exceed actual capture completion; retained capture/receipt timestamps after explicit caller clock fail health.
All individually valid source asset observations participate in revision detection even if the other asset is missing.
Duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite JSON constants, ambiguous schema types and heartbeat capital/clock mismatches cannot certify health.
Provider refusals retain permanent stop behavior across restart, network opt-out and backup/restore.
Orphan incomplete/late capture after interrupted writer remains unhealthy without its failure event; later genuine complete/timely source-bound success may recover without erasing earlier bytes.

independent_review_finding_closed.reproduction: With or without prior successful collection, append valid incomplete source without an event and write fresh heartbeat: before correction heartbeat_healthy=True; after correction fail-closed until later source-bound complete/timely success.
independent_review_finding_closed.resolution: Health reads retained quality timestamps from strict source manifest; provider-stop preflight remains distinct so transient source quality does not permanently prevent collection.
